mainEntity.name: How much does water damage interior repair cost in Denver and nearby suburbs?

acceptedAnswer.text: In Denver-area homes, water damage restoration often runs from about $1,251 to $4,647 on average, with many repairs landing around $2 to $5.25 per square foot depending on the damage. Costs rise when water has spread behind walls, affected flooring, or required more demolition and rebuild work.
acceptedAnswer.description: Costs vary by size and severity, but Denver-area repairs often fall in the low thousands and can increase when hidden moisture requires more demolition and rebuilding.
